name: ═══════════════ TELEGRAM BOT CORE INTERFACE ═══════════════
info:
## Telegram Bot Core Interface

**Flow Number:** 50

### Purpose
Core Telegram bot infrastructure and cross-domain commands.

### Responsibilities
- Bot receiver and event handling
- Command parsing and filtering
- Cross-domain commands: /help, /commands
- Chat ID management
- Authorization

### NOT Handled Here
- Domain-specific commands (server, gates, lights, irrigation, etc.)
  These are handled by dedicated flows:
  - 12-server-telegram.json
  - 212-gate-telegram.json
  - 221-sliding-gate-telegram.json
  - 231-secondary-gate-telegram.json
  - 311-garden-power-telegram.json
  - 321-garden-lights-telegram.json
  - 411-water-pump-telegram.json
  - 812-victron-energy-telegram.json

### Dependencies
- telegram_bot_config (shared across all flows)

### Integration
All domain-specific flows have their own telegram receivers and filter commands independently.

        [{ text: '📷 Camera Status', callback_data: '/camera_status' }, { text: '❓ Camera Help', callback_data: '/camera_help' }],
        [{ text: '❓ Quick Help', callback_data: '/help' }, { text: '🔄 Refresh List', callback_data: '/commands' }]
    ]
};

msg.payload = {
    chatId: msg.telegram.chatId,
    type: 'message',
    content: commandsText,
    parse_mode: 'Markdown',
    options: {
        reply_markup: JSON.stringify(inlineKeyboard)
    }
};
msg.topic = 'send';

return msg;
